parsed.post: Discarding MATRIX_LR=0.06; it slightly degraded performance (1.0146 vs 1.0105). Reverting to MATRIX_LR=0.05. Next, I'll test increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 80 to see if width scaling continues to provide gains on this DEPTH=6/LR=0.05 base.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 80 on the current best branch (DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.05) to probe further width/capacity scaling.
